description: Registry of thesis/dissertation output-format classes and institution profiles for the dataimago dissertation vertical. Consumed by dissertation-ai onboarding (interview Q15), Level-3 generated-app PDF builds, and the Level-3 author harness. The unit is one house class plus a profile per institution. See docs/discovery-contract.md.

modes.shipped: A profile exists in this registry for the institution; use the house class with that profile as-is.
modes.vendored: The author supplies their institution's own class; normalize it here and optionally contribute back.
modes.generated: No profile exists for the institution; the author's AI starts from the house profile and adapts it from written guidelines, validates it, and may contribute it back.

classes.notes: The house class. Everything an institution's guide decides lives in a profile, compiled to profiles/<id>.cfg, which the class reads; select it with the class option profile=<id> (Quarto: thesis.profile). Build with LuaLaTeX (tagged PDF); XeLaTeX is supported and untagged. Use in a Quarto book: see classes/dataimago-thesis/README.md.

classes.lineage: John P. Weiss (1997) → maintained through v1.14; hyperref-compatible (Ni 2014); signature page removed, committee on title page (Anderson 2020)
classes.notes: Unlicensed feature reference for the house class (University of Colorado Boulder, kept in the tree). Never offered to authors and never fetched by a build: the institution's shipped option is the `profiles` entry with id cu-boulder (class dataimago-thesis).

profiles.notes: The neutral dataimago default; no institution's guide stands behind it. The starting profile for the generated mode, adapted from the author's written guidelines. Never a shipped option and never the framework default of the interview (shipped always names an institution's profile).

profiles.guide: CU Boulder Graduate School, Specifications for Preparation of Master's Theses & Doctoral Dissertations (web page, revised 2018, 2023, 2026)
profiles.notes: Values cite the Graduate School's guide, CU's Thesis Accessibility Guidance or ProQuest's manuscript guide in the profile's `sources` (each entry names its document), or are marked inferred. Fields none of the three states are listed under `unstated` in the profile and keep the house value; that includes tagged PDF, the PDF/A level and PDF/UA, which no CU or ProQuest document sets. Read `unstated` and `sources` before claiming the guide is met.
